root.label: Revolut covers costs for customers affected by data hack

events.label: Revolut covers costs for customers affected by data hack

slots.name: ransom demands received
slots.sentence: Revolut previously said it had not received a ransom demand.

slots.name: affected clients
slots.sentence: Cossa-Dumurgier said Revolut had provided assistance for the 680 affected clients, 55 of whom are in France.

slots.name: system compromise status
slots.sentence: Cossa-Dumurgier said that government agencies are sometimes the "weak link" in the system and that Revolut's own systems had not been compromised.
